[1/3] checkers read correct answers in any common form and mark unreadable replies; [2/3] run records keep answer text and count unreadable vs wrong; [3/3] about 30 chat and more long-context questions, suite v12

impact_assessment.why: Correct answers failed on wording (2 of 6 exact, 4 of 7 choice, 3 of 5 number); the user asked to fix and to add chat and long-context questions
impact_assessment.benefits: Scores reflect correctness, not wording; tuning stops favouring terse prompts; chat and long context measured properly
impact_assessment.risks: contract: scoring changes, suite v12 makes saved profiles stale; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: run records grow with answer text
impact_assessment.mitigation: Tests for correct-but-formatted and wrong-or-hedged replies; reference checks for new items; ADRs; CHANGELOG

[1/2] hold back a quarter of each task's items and re-check each preset against defaults on them, falling back when worse; [2/2] show results on unseen questions in Details and run statistics; then restart the v12 baseline

impact_assessment.why: Presets are chosen and scored on the same items, so their gains are optimistic; the user asked to continue with the held-out check
impact_assessment.benefits: An honest gain per preset on questions the tune never saw, and no preset that is worse than defaults on them
impact_assessment.risks: contract: tuning items shrink by a quarter (math tunes on 38), rungs and task hash change, profiles carry holdout; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: profiles gain a holdout field
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests; ADR-054 names the changed rung test; real run
